items.title: Lew Soloff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: the first person who made me aware of it very clearly was Warren Vache actually, who I’m a great admirer of. And I was telling him — this was years ago and I was doing a lot of studio work

ctx.x: The Rainforest thing, yeah. Elton John, Billy Joel, Sting, Gladys Knight, Sam Moore who lives here, from Sam & Dave, who lives in Phoenix, Tom Jones, Martha from Martha and the Vandellas. Stevie Wonder sat in. And I’ll tell you it was just thrilling. It was thrilling to play this music with these people. And all this stuff goes into my music. It’s all a part of my music. Gil Evans made me aware of Jimi Hendrix. Even though I played on the same bill with him back with Blood, Sweat & Tears. I really didn’t…
